	DefaultMaxDecodedBytes = 1 << 30

const Format = "pdf"

type Extractor struct {
	MaxStreamBytes int64

	ObjectStreamCacheBytes int64

	ObjectCacheBytes int64

	MaxShapes int
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

type File struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

type Line struct {
	Text string

	BBox gofastcore.Rect

	Block int

	Hidden gofastcore.Hidden

	Font string
	Size float64

	Words []Word
}

type Page struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

type Word struct {
	Text string

	BBox gofastcore.Rect
}
